_note: Schema reference only — not loaded by the app. Topic files are GENERATED by content-edit/topics/export-topic-content.py from topic-publication-mapping-YYYY-MM-DD.xlsx. Edit the spreadsheet and re-run; do not hand-edit public/content/topics/*.json, it will be overwritten.
description: Plain-language definition of the research area, roughly 230-290 characters. From the sheet's Wiki-description column. A topic with no papers still needs one — it is then the whole panel.

featured.title: Exact paper title as published
featured.authors: A. Author, B. Author, and C. Author — full list; the renderer truncates to three plus et al.
featured.venue: Journal or conference name. Short form preferred; the renderer strips a leading 'Proceedings of the'.
featured.summary: One or two sentences on what the paper investigates. NOTE: as of 2026-09-03 these are machine-generated from the title and topic, not xG-RIC editorial text — see decision log 35. Real ones are still owed.

citations.url: https://... — search or provider URL, so the count can be audited

publications.title: Every other publication for this topic, in sheet order
publications.summary: Carried so the panel can use it later without a re-export; not currently rendered in the list.
publications.citations: Same shape as above. Present on 113 of 437 papers — journal publications only. A missing count means the paper is a conference paper, preprint or thesis; it does NOT mean zero, and must never render as '0 citations'.

_omitted: Both 'featured' and 'publications' are absent entirely when a topic has no papers. The renderer then shows the description card alone, which is a complete panel rather than an empty state. Four topics are in this position: quantum_key_distribution, federated_learning, network_architecture, split_8.
